subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When the gate runs, it shall verify that the source map and `Serves` joins assemble consistently — no `Serves` target naming a nonexistent requirement, no requirement in a broken supersession state (a `superseded_by` resolving nowhere or forming a cycle), and no cyclic design build-on chain — failing with a **compilability** defect naming each malformed join.
rationale: the assembly must be a well-formed graph before anything consumes it as one
fit_criterion: fixtures seeding an orphan `Serves`, a dangling `superseded_by`, and a build-on cycle each yield a `malformed` verdict naming the join; a well-formed fixture passes
